# Employee Handbook (excerpt)

## Vacation

Full-time employees receive 25 paid vacation days per year. Unused days carry over until 31 March of the following year. Vacation requests are approved by the team lead.

## Remote work

Employees may work remotely up to three days a week after the first three months. Equipment for the home office is paid by the company up to 500 euros.
